input.quote: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: We have a convenience right on one month's notice (acceptable) and IBM has no mid-term walk-away, but the right is conditioned on uncapped early termination charges defined in attachments and there is no refund of prepaid charges. Redline caps the charges at three months' fees and adds a pro-rata refund.

input.quote: will renew automatically for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term
input.rationale: Automatic renewal repeats the prior term (potentially multi-year) and the non-renewal window is 90 days, exceeding our 30-day preferred (60-day fallback) limit. Redline sets 12-month renewals with a 30-day opt-out; note 13.1 permits IBM price changes after 12 months on 90 days' notice, which we would also want capped.

input.quote: This Agreement will be governed by the substantive laws of the State of New York, without regard for its conflict of laws provisions.
input.rationale: New York law is our preferred governing law and there is no arbitration clause or foreign venue; the agreement is silent on forum, which leaves ordinary court jurisdiction available, so no redline is required (we would add exclusive New York County venue if the clause is otherwise reopened).

input.quote: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld.
input.rationale: The consent restriction binds only us, with a successor carve-out but no affiliate carve-out and no restriction on IBM's ability to assign (including to our competitors). Redline adds the affiliate/successor carve-out, confirms no change-of-control right for IBM and makes the consent requirement mutual.
